data.narrative:
SwarmFarm Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised AU$30M+ to date. The peer universe comprises 3 same-stage, same-sector private comparables (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity) alongside a broader set of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised ($30M) as a proxy for post-money valuation, applies a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, implying a valuation of $57M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 core comparables yields a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. The disparity between these methods reflects the heterogeneity in scale and performance within the Series B robotics cohort.

The triangulated analysis produces a range of $48M to $2.0B, with a median of $904M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression methods assume normalized capital efficiency across the frontier-robotics sector, while peer-median approaches are sensitive to the specific composition and maturity profile of available comparables. Reconciliation of this range requires clarification on SwarmFarm's revenue, growth rate, capital efficiency, and specific technical differentiation relative to the identified peer set.
